# Parse flight status output
def extract_json(raw):
    # Remove ANSI escape codes
    clean = re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-9;]*m', '', raw)
    # Find JSON object
    start = clean.find('{')
    if start == -1:
        start = clean.find('[')
    if start == -1:
        return None
    # Remove trailing (.venv) etc
    text = clean[start:].split('(.venv)')[0].strip()
    return json.loads(text)
